breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The user's request incorrectly applied gravity horizontally (-X direction) for a simulation of natural convection heated from below (along the Z-axis). The agent correctly identified this physical inconsistency and changed the gravity vector to `(0 0 -9.81)`, which aligns gravity with the vertical temperature gradient, correctly setting up the simulation to drive the buoyant instability.
